summary: NHC/OP, L.P., a wholly-owned subsidiary of National HealthCare Corporation (NHC), entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire five skilled nursing facilities (four in Tennessee, one in South Carolina) from National Health Corporation for $50.5 million, subject to a net book value adjustment and offset for unpaid management fees. The buyer made a $750,000 deposit, refundable during inspection (through ~June 16, 2026), then non-refundable. Closing, expected in Q2 2026, requires NHC obtaining acceptable financing. A $2.0 million escrow fund will cover indemnification for 12 months post-close. Watch inspection-period termination right and financing conditions.
